summary.headline: Planetary Lots and Aspects
summary.text: Astrological nativity interpretations of benefics, malefics, lots, horoskopos, daimons, and planetary places, including effects on piety, prophecy, children, marriage, livelihood, health, and longevity. Discusses Zeus trine the Sun, Kronos trine the Sun, planetary trines, squares, hexagons, and the differing effects of aspects at pivots and succedents.
